profile.name: Ganesh Derkar
headline: Thoughtful code.
Useful software.
profile.intro: I’m Ganesh, a Full Stack Software Developer at Endava. I build intuitive interfaces, dependable APIs, and applications that connect the two.
bio: I’m a Full Stack Software Developer at Endava with a background in Computer Engineering from MIT Academy of Engineering. I enjoy working across the stack, from the details of a responsive interface to the structure of a backend service.

My toolkit includes React, Angular, .NET Web API, and microservices. I work with Docker and GitHub Actions for delivery, and use OpenAI and Gemini API integrations in my projects to explore practical AI features.
I’m interested in software that is easy to use and easy to maintain. Spec-driven development with Spec Kit helps me connect requirements, implementation plans, and the code that follows.

projects.title: NetflixGPT
projects.subtitle: Find your next film
projects.description: Find films through AI recommendations, browse TMDB movie collections, and watch trailers in one React app.
projects.overview: NetflixGPT brings movie discovery and trailer playback into one interface. I connected TMDB movie data with Gemini recommendations and Firebase authentication, using Redux to share application state across the browsing experience.
highlights: Browse now-playing, popular, and top-rated movies from TMDB, alongside Gemini-powered recommendations.
Open trailers from movie posters in a modal that also closes with the Escape key.
Reuse trailer-fetching logic through custom hooks and share movie data through Redux.

projects.title: Food Delivery
projects.subtitle: Food browsing, built with React
projects.description: A food browsing interface with API-driven listings, page navigation, and shared React hooks.
projects.overview: This project explores the frontend of a food delivery application. I connected external API content to reusable React components and used React Router for navigation, with custom hooks keeping shared stateful logic out of individual views.
highlights: Use React Router to move between views without a full-page reload.
Populate the interface with external API data rather than hardcoded listings.
Share stateful logic through custom hooks so components can focus on rendering.

projects.title: devTender
projects.subtitle: Exploring the service layer
projects.description: A Node.js service layer using Express for request handling and MongoDB for document storage.
projects.overview: devTender is my backend-focused exploration of application services. The project brings together an Express server and MongoDB persistence, keeping server-side logic separate from the interface.
highlights: Handle application requests with a Node.js and Express service layer.
Store application data as documents in MongoDB.
Keep server-side logic separate from frontend rendering.

projects.title: Task Manager
projects.subtitle: A little more organized
projects.description: Create, edit, complete, and search everyday tasks in a focused React interface.
projects.overview: A small productivity application built to make everyday tasks easy to manage while practicing React state management and functional components.
highlights: Create, edit, and delete tasks.
Mark tasks complete and find them through search.
Responsive interface built with functional components and hooks.

projects.title: Image to Text
projects.subtitle: Making image content usable
projects.description: Extract readable text from images using optical character recognition.
projects.overview: A project exploring optical character recognition to extract text from image-based sources. The linked repository contains the project implementation.
highlights: Text extraction from image input.
An exploration of optical character recognition workflows.

projects.title: Auto Pause Video
projects.subtitle: A small extension for focused browsing
projects.description: A Firefox extension that pauses video playback when you switch to another tab.
projects.overview: A browser utility built to prevent videos from continuing to play in a tab you have left. The extension responds to tab changes and pauses playback.
highlights: Automatically pauses video when switching tabs.
A focused browser utility with a small JavaScript codebase.
Open-source project released under the MIT license.

projects.title: Commerce Services
projects.subtitle: An API-first commerce concept
projects.description: Planned catalog and order APIs using .NET, Docker, and GitHub Actions.
projects.overview: A proposed portfolio project for demonstrating microservice boundaries and repeatable delivery. This is a concept, not a completed implementation.
highlights: Planned: independent catalog and order APIs.
Planned: containerized local development with Docker.
Planned: automated build and test workflows with GitHub Actions.

projects.title: AI Workspace
projects.subtitle: One interface. Two AI providers.
projects.description: A planned Angular workspace connecting OpenAI and Gemini through a .NET API.
projects.overview: A proposed application for exploring AI-assisted workflows through a common interface. Provider credentials would live on the server. This is a concept, not a completed implementation.
highlights: Planned: an Angular interface styled with Bootstrap.
Planned: provider integrations through a server-side API.
Planned: useful loading, error, and response states.

projects.title: Spec-driven Starter
projects.subtitle: From a clear spec to working code
projects.description: A planned starter connecting Spec Kit specifications with implementation tasks and automated checks.
projects.overview: A proposed development starter that keeps the problem statement and implementation plan close to the code. This is a concept, not a completed implementation.
highlights: Planned: a specification-to-implementation workflow.
Planned: documented development and review tasks.
Planned: containerized setup and automated checks.
